title: Prefix Tree
prompt:
Implement a struct `PrefixTree` that stores lowercase words and supports:

  PrefixTree::new()                       create an empty tree
  insert(&mut self, word: &str)           add word to the tree
  contains(&self, word: &str) -> bool     true if word was inserted exactly
  has_prefix(&self, prefix: &str) -> bool true if any inserted word starts with prefix
  count_prefix(&self, prefix: &str) -> usize
                                          how many inserted words start with prefix (inserting the same word twice counts once)

The empty string is a prefix of every word. Build it as a trie of nodes (you will want to add your own node type and fields) rather than scanning a list of words.

Example:
  let mut t = PrefixTree::new();
  t.insert("card"); t.insert("care");
  t.contains("car") -> false
  t.has_prefix("car") -> true
  t.count_prefix("car") -> 2
